story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.after: We have not yet informed <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> that we managed to pull out the <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>. It makes sense to re-think who exactly we should continue to cooperate with. Apparently <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color>, <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>, and even <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> are all very interested in obtaining the recovered device... or artifact? Doesn’t matter. You choose who we work for next, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.briefing: Our scanners can't trace the <color=#FFFEC1>device</color>. It is likely located somewhere <color=#FFFEC1>deep underground</color>. Look for the <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color> down. The geodesic is partially destroyed, so we will drop you right in the territory of the colony. I'm noticing some other signals, but they're not quasimorphs. I think these are some poorly armed <color=#FFFEC1>marauders</color>: former <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> Sec officers, fugitive PMC mercs, pirates who broke into the Inner System, and so on. Shouldn't be any problems.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.details:
Details: In the Oddibjord-3 colony, under a huge geodesic dome, there is a large laboratory complex that belonged to the Fresco Corporation. The goal is to find and evacuate the device that the guys from AnCom want to get. The colony has been destroyed as a result of continuous fighting on the surface of Venus since the appearance of Tezctlan. Now the quasimorphs loyal to him have captured the geodesic and will protect it no matter who appears there.

Additional Info: The Hexarchy, the union of six major corporations, has increased censorship. Of course, they deny the very existence of censorship. They say it is a concept from the distant past, when the nation states still existed. But we don’t believe that nonsense, do we, Boss? They control the largest routers in the System. The actions the hexarchs have taken to enhance their control over are associated with the appearance of Tezctlan on Venus. It will be easier for laborers and middle managers to work if they do not know about the monsters that prowl around them.

Because of our active participation in events, we know that the former assets of the destroyed concern Fresco on Venus became a battlefield between various forces and factions. The intensity of quasimorphic events on Venus is extremely high. And then our old customer AnCom crops up again. We were extremely lucky to find that PCPU at the Civil Resistance base. It seems that AnCom is hiding its success in advanced experiments with quasimorphosis carried out behind the backs of the other hexarchs.

HIS Unveiled, owned by AnCom, has been in the orbit of Venus for a while and is clearly engaged in a comprehensive study of its surface. And now AnCom has shared something with us.

As we thought, the accusation that the Civil Resistance has been fabricating quasimorphic activity on Venus is a lie. It looks like Tezctlan is trying to drag the quasimorphs of its bramfatura into our world. There are reports of successful phasing of huge structures. It’s a good opportunity to raise prices and start getting some real pleasure.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.ancom_after: Greetings, mercenary. You might be interested in another short-term contract. The task is simple: retrieve our property. Again. You have shown that you are quite good at this. The mission target is the colony of <color=#FFFEC1>Oddibjord-3</color> on <color=#FFFEC1>Venus</color>. The data has already been uploaded to the Magnum. When you’re ready, get started. Over and out.

We confirm that this is a small task force of RealWare Sec fighters. Their corporate transponders are turned off, which means they are not covered by NCE. Such episodes among the hexarchs are rare, but this is a good chance to obtain information about the true balance of power in the System.

To facilitate the fulfillment of the contract we dropped two autonomous capsules with resources and promising prototypes from the Unveiled. A great opportunity for you to complete the mission, and for us to conduct field tests. The main goal of the contract does not change. We don't see anything you can't handle.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.ancom_playe: Attention, <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Unveiled</color> is speaking! Magnum, we have to inform you that the mission has been <color=#FFFEC1>canceled</color>. Unfortunately, contractual obligations will be revoked. We observe a large concentration of the enemy in the mission area. A decision was made to launch a tactical nuclear strike. Goal: protection of the intellectual property of AnCom corporation. Your presence in Oddibjord-3 is from thie moment considered a violation of the AnCom Information Security Protocol. Article 12, Section C, Paragraph 3 of the Public Declaration. Over and out.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.jane_after_: Boss, the digital sequences of the contract issued to us by <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> are partially generated or rewritten. If I may say so, the contract looks somewhat suspicious. It is likely that the mission is not about retrieving property, but rather seizing someone else’s. Considering that most of the assets on Venus previously belonged to the <color=#FFFEC1>Fresco</color> Corporation, I suspect we are after something from their advanced research. This is a tempting target for many. Are you interested in being at the center of a conflict among several corporations, Boss?

I detect a signal! You're still alive. The elevator collapsed to the lower level of Oddibjord-3. The device must be <color=#FFFEC1>somewhere nearby</color>. I detect very powerful bursts of quasimorphic activity throughout the entire floor. Looks like you'll have to fight your way out.

These are <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> operators. The signatures are disabled, but everything is clear here. I bet they're looking for the same thing that we are. I'll take a long sip from my "I told you so" mug while I send this data to AnCom. Let's see their reaction.

There must be a quasimorphic artifact nearby. Take it and return to the shuttle. This is exactly what we were sent for. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> reinforcements are arriving at Oddibjord-3, you need to get out of there quickly.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.jane_player: Sensors have detected the activation of the HIS Unveiled’s thrusters. This is an AnCom spacecraft in orbit around Venus. Our approximation shows the ship reaching the position to drop the bomb from orbit on Oddibjord-3. They don't have enough time to aim accurately, so you'll be hit only with debris, a shock front, and EMP. Bastards. Run to the shuttle and don't break the damn thing.

When you get to ground level, <color=#FFFEC1>immediately</color> move towards the shuttle. RealWare reinforcements have already taken up defensive positions along the entire perimeter. Show them what you can do.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.realware_ar: I’m broadcasting on an open channel. You’re good for a mercenary. You should have thought about collaborating with RealWare. AnCom are murderers and scammers. It's too late now. The entire sector is under our control. This time you will be eliminated. Over and out.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.realware_co: Open channel. It's a pleasure doing business with you. Our soldiers have not received combat experience like that since the Calypso incident. I hope you're not going to give up. Over and out.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.dlg.reaper_onpl: Why are violence and sanctity so intertwined? Why is death necessary for life to continue? The Master warned that someone would come for the <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>. And he even predicted that it would be the herald of the one thanks to whom he came to life again in your world. I'm not sorry that you decided to turn your weapons against <color=#FFFEC1>the Emerald Emperor</color>. Your blood will give me new power.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.name: Community and Anarchy
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.objective0: You need to pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> device—if it really is <color=#FFFEC1>their</color> device. You will have to search all over <color=#FFFEC1>Oddibjord-3</color>.
story.anc_1_comm_anarchy.objective1: <color=#FFFEC1>We've got the device</color>. What is it this time? The <color=#FFFEC1>Crystal Skull</color>? I'm not sure we should have gotten involved in this.

story.anc_2_mib.after: Good job, Boss. <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> took the target along with the chip, but we managed to scan it first. The data confirms many of the guesses about the so-called <color=#FFFEC1>"hive mind"</color> that is the Civil Resistance. But the threads stretch even further. It is a branching complex network with an internal hierarchy, run by some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>council</color>. Our old friend <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> is one of the members of that council. What really interests me is why AnCom needed this chip. For something that can be used against quasimorphs?
story.anc_2_mib.briefing:
This is Jamame, the Solar System's bandit fortress. Consider yourself lucky. Raid into Legend. I repeat the task: Seize the Hellstrom chip intact.

Resistance will likely be fierce. But the real challenge isn't clearing the base, it's finding a key colnode. Then learning how to get the chip intact. They probably know what to do with the chip to keep it out of enemy hands. Don't give them a chance to do that, whatever it is.
story.anc_2_mib.details:
Details: The AnCom corporation requires us to organize a sortie for a Hellstrom chip. The target should be a key colonode of the Civil Resistance, so there is no need to worry about covering our tracks. From the transferred materials, it is clear that the chip is incredibly important for developments in the field of neuroauthorization. They have classified the rest of the information, leaving us to guess at the real value of the chip.

The specification contains a detailed description of one case of chip damage and traces of classification of several other such cases. AnCom clearly needs a "living" specimen. Either the mercenary will have to improvise, or you come up with something in advance.

Additional Info: Judging by the scraps of data, the Resistance has its own motivation to protect secrets at any cost. The Civil Resistance is a deeply secretive organization. It seems the chip may shed light on its nature. Expect fierce resistance.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.ancom_space: Magnum, the board expresses restrained joy at your wise decision to restore relations with <color=#FFFEC1>AnСom</color>. Your recent work has fully proven your loyalty to the brand. We have another mission for your company. Details have just been sent to your onboard mainframe. We are looking for the so-called <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom chip</color>. Despite the abundance of wild rumors about the chip itself and its creator, leave them to the content makers of the SBN and take the mission as seriously as possible.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.issahar_1: This is <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>. We have come to personally greet you, mercenary, and to warn you. Think about who you are fighting against. You are fighting against humanity itself, against our <color=#FFFEC1>common future</color>. Think again. You are also an <color=#FFFEC1>outcast</color> within this rotten social system, just like us. Those in power wipe their feet on you, just like they do on us. Do you still think that they will reward you for your loyalty? For your service? For your sacrifice? Do not delude yourself. Know that we are open to honest dialogue with you and mutually beneficial cooperation.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_after_monster_k: Hellstrom's chip self-destructs upon death, so we need to <color=#FFFEC1>stun the enemy with a shock weapon</color> first.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_colnode_stunned: This chip has self-destructed, and it <color=#FFFEC1>won't work for us</color>. We need to try to capture someone <color=#FFFEC1>in charge</color>.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_space: Let me remind you, boss, that <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> has put us in harm's way more than once before. Whatever you decide about their offer, I recommend not trusting the corps. The data they've provided is heavily censored. What little is usable comes down to autopsy and interrogation logs of <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> members. AnCom already has at least one copy of the Helstrom chip, but it has burned out and is worthless. Given how AnCom has only captured low rank Civil Resistance members, I can safely assume that what we're going to need is definitely not your <color=#FFFEC1>rank-and-file colnode</color>. That's why they're suggesting we attack their main base.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_stage3_after_al: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is sending reinforcements! Be on guard!
The target's chip burned out after death! We need to find another one. AnCom won't accept this one.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_start: Boots on the ground. Don't relax. Your goal is to find a key colnode, and figure out how to take the chip intact. Work quickly and smoothly.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.jane_to_issahar: Wow, he <color=#FFFEC1>shot himself</color>? We've been scanning the station this whole time and found an interesting VPN tunnel that ended at your interlocutor and started somewhere beyond our line of sight. At some other station in the Main Belt. We won't meet <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> here personally. However, we'll now try to suppress all such connections so that he doesn't interfere with our mission.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.stage2_alert: Attention! Threat detected. Activating Protocol-2. Defense system activated.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.stage3_back_to_lift_: <color=#FFFEC1>Revolution</color> happens when there is no other way, mercenary. We carry <color=#FFFEC1>the flame of freedom</color> to every person. Corporate tyranny will be overthrown with or without you.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.stage3_jane: Great, you're alive! I'm picking up multiple human signatures on this level. The one we need is definitely among them. In addition to capturing them alive, we also need to protect them from their former allies.
story.anc_2_mib.dlg.stage3_jane_stun_1_o: The target appears disoriented. The chip has gone into reboot. We have time to evacuate immediately. I repeat—<color=#FFFEC1>immediately</color>! All enemy target signatures on the station have begun to move. Let's get out of here and fast!
story.anc_2_mib.name: Men in Black
story.anc_2_mib.objective0: Find the key colnode and find a way to deliver the intact Hellstrom chip to the Magnum.

story.anc_3_reload.after:
Immediately after quasimorph activity on the Moon ceased, AnCom declared SBN traitors to humanity and seized control of their assets. This is an annexation of their entire information infrastructure. Their communiqué covers both that and their anti-quasimorph technology. The whole Solar System now knows AnCom can extinguish bramfaturas. They present it as a guarantee of security. But it sounds like blackmail, boss.

There is some good news, if that word even applies today. Dr. Eipschwitz managed to copy the signatures of the Andreev Emitter and run them through those same AnCom secret data. The result is a recipe for the Phase Bomb. I have already uploaded it to the Magnum fabricator.

Meanwhile, AnCom is announcing Mars as their next objective. They say that from there, they will be able to deal with the remaining problems of the system. I do not like the way they say "deal with" now.
story.anc_3_reload.briefing:
Your task is to reach the SBN control computer and install the Andreev Emitter in it.

AnCom did not transfer the device aboard the Magnum. They will send the Emitter in a separate transport capsule after deployment. Find a suitable receiving airlock, accept the capsule, and retrieve the device.

According to the station layout, the airlock level should provide direct access to the control block. If we are lucky, we can avoid a long walk through the service sectors. If not... well, business as usual.
story.anc_3_reload.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Place the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> into the station control computer.
story.anc_3_reload.details:
Details: AnCom requires us to carry out an operation against another hexarch—SBN. The target is the control computer of Fuller's Core Station.

The Andreev Emitter must be delivered to the computer and installed. Once connected, the emitter should use the station's infrastructure to generate a pulse theoretically capable of extinguishing the Moon's bramfatura.

The problem is that AnCom does not trust us. Remember the PCPU with the secret data? Looks like when we returned it to the client, AnCom detected audit traces showing that its contents had been copied. That is why they will not transfer the emitter aboard the Magnum in advance.

After deployment, the operative must receive AnCom's transport capsule directly on the station, retrieve the Andreev Emitter, and only then deliver it to the control computer. Naturally, the station owner will treat this as an attack and respond accordingly.

Additional Info: Formally, the control computer is responsible for Fuller's orbital position relative to the Moon. But with SBN, even orbital automation is rarely just orbital automation.

According to AnCom, this node also functions as a high-level transmitter-router. Through it, SBN maintains a communication circuit effectively enveloping the Moon and its near orbits. If the intel is accurate, the computer will be able to amplify the resonance of the Andreev Emitter and simultaneously propagate the pulse across the entire lunar region.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.ancom_qmorph100: The growth of quasimorphosis is confirmed. Our backdoors in the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> networks report that <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> is reacting to the Emitter's presence. The signature could not be shielded completely, and the bramfatura senses danger.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.fokerma_qmorph500: We have heard thy call, heralds of Gagtungr. Through thy hissing machines, thy despair before the coming Hive has reached us. And <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> deigns to answer. Let the bearer of emptiness pass on. We shall meet him beside thy soldiers—in every corridor, in every chamber, in every place where thy station circled above that harsh mistress, the <color=#FFFEC1>Moon</color>.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.intro_reload:
AnCom is moving from defense to offense. Excellent work, mercenary.

Up until now, we have been containing the consequences: stabilizing quasimorphosis surges and channels of penetration into physical reality. That was necessary, but not sufficient. You cannot keep buying time forever against a process that behaves like a law of nature.

Using Hellstrom technologies and our own anti-quasimorph developments, we have created a device capable of extinguishing bramfaturas—depriving them of stable contact with both quasimorphic and physical reality. We believe that, for a bramfatura, this means destruction.

Before deployment on Venus, the parameters must be calibrated. The target of the first test is Duggur, a more conventional bramfatura, but one that poses a direct threat to Earth.

Proceed to Fuller's Core Station on Fuller. Find the SBN control computer. Their networks cover the entire Moon and its near orbits. That infrastructure will be sufficient to generate a pulse of the required power.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.jane_qmorph100: Confirmed. The quasimorph sensors are not behaving normally. If AnCom is trying to use us blindly again, I won't be held responsible for my actions. I am tired of pulling you out of the line of fire.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.sbn_qmorph100: Attention, all personnel assigned to station defense. <color=#FFFEC1>Annunciation Protocol</color> will be activated. Prepare for the arrival of gamma-class reinforcements.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage1_ancom_caps: Suitable receiving airlock detected. The capsule is en route to your position. The <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> has been delivered to the site. Retrieve the device and proceed to the control computer.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage1_ancom_lift: You need to take the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> with you. Go back and retrieve the device before proceeding.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage1_jane_devic: Careful! Every quasimorph sensor just went completely off the charts. Looks like all of <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> is ready to crash down on the station.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage2_jane_greet: SNAFU. Listen carefully, there is no direct lift to the control level. Ahead of you is a large service sector. SBN is pulling in everything they have, and the quasimorphs really do seem to be covering their defense. Do not linger. You need the lift to the third level.
story.anc_3_reload.dlg.stage3_ancom_comp: There it is. The <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> control computer. Through this node, they held the <color=#FFFEC1>Moon</color> in their networks. I never liked them. A corporation incapable of distinguishing communication and coordination from actual power... Connect the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color>. If the calculations are correct, <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> will feel the pulse immediately.

Installation confirmed. Activating the Emitter.

A process like this cannot be undone. Duggur will be extinguished. Evacuation is authorized for the operative. We will prepare the communiqué for the ancap system.
